usageNotes: Returns the list of disk-related sub-resource endpoints available under the specified node (e.g., list, smart, initgpt, wipedisk). Use this to discover what disk operations are supported before calling a specific sub-endpoint. Requires the node to be online; the response is a directory index, not actual disk data.

examples.summary: List available disk sub-resources on node 'pve1'

tips: This is a directory index only — to get actual disk inventory, call get_nodes_node_disks_list instead.
All authenticated users can call this endpoint; no elevated privilege is required.
The returned 'name' values in each object correspond to child API paths you can call next (e.g., 'list', 'smart', 'initgpt', 'wipedisk', 'directory', 'zfs', 'lvm', 'lvmthin').
